CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content found.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its presentation/access label (current) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim is linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names specific represented content (coordinate set) with an attribute (red).

D.rationale: The report separates identification of content (red coordinates) from its provenance/status (origin field) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The 'current' label and the explicit mapping show how the content is presented/accessed at the stated time.
